description: Opus R unit 6: every Pokemon faints at once. p1's Weezing uses Explosion with its ally and both foes at 1 HP: the user is queued to faint first (selfdestruct 'always'), then the targets in target order (adjacent ally, then foes). faintMessages ends on the last dequeued entry, a p2 Pokemon, and checkWin gives the win to that entry's side when no side has a Pokemon left: p2 wins. Extremes mode (damage rolls min and max).
